ထိုသို့သဘော ရှိသည်။
DOP: tathā adv. [ ts ], Abh 1142; Sadd 805, 13 foll. (sabbanāmehi thātatthā pakāravacane: so pakāro tathā, taṃ pakāraṃ tathā, tena pakārena tathā); 1. so, thus; in that wa y; like that (frequently followed by eva) ; Vin III 36, 25 (so bhikkhu tathā akāsi); IV 135, 26 (evaṃ ca pana so bhikkhu bhikkhūhi vuccamāno tath’ eva paggaṇheyya); D I 88, 22 foll. (yadi vā taṃ bhavantaṃ Gotamaṃ tathā santaṃ yeva saddo abbhuggato yadi vā no tathā); M I 520, 7 (satthuno anussavasaccassa sussutaṃ pi hoti dussutaṃ pi hoti tathā pi hoti aññathā pi hoti); S II 100, 17 (ambho kathaṃ so puriso ti tath’ eva deva jīvatī ti); A II 22, 12 (tayidaṃ bho Gotama tath’ eva); 24, 5 (sabbaṃ taṃ tath’ eva hoti no aññathā tasmā tathāgato ti vuccati, Be, Ce, Se so; Ee wr tatth’ eva); Sn 375 (addhā hi bhagavā tath’ eva etaṃ); 789 (diṭṭhī hi naṃ pāva tathā vadānaṃ); 908 (jānāmi passāmi tath’ eva etaṃ; Nidd I 323, 14 foll. : etaṃ tathaṃ tacchaṃ bhūtaṃ …); Th 118 (rūpam aññam iva tath’ eva santaṃ); 374 (atthaṃ ca ñatvāna tathā karoti); Ja II 156, 7 (taṃ rājānaṃ tathā paridevamānaṃ disvā); III 156, 19* (tath’ eva tiṭṭhati sīsaṃ; 156, 23´ : yathā pubbe ṭhitaṃ tath’ eva tiṭṭhati); IV 234, 25 (rājā pan’ assa matabhāvaṃ ajānanto tathā nisinno va ahosi); Paṭis II 227, 14 (so bahuṃ ce pi ādisati tath’ eva taṃ hoti no aññathā); Ap 83, 9 (ye keci pādapā sabbe mahiyā te virūhare buddhimanto tathā sattā rūhanti jinasāsane); Mil 123, 7 (evaṃ etaṃ tathā sampaṭicchāmī ti); Pj II 602, 11 (tena sabbo pi tathā vuttappakāro loko veditabbo); Mhv 20:41 (dīpaṃ tu sakalaṃ pana ānubhāvena devānaṃ tathevālaṅkataṃ ahu); — 2. so also; in the same way ; D I 251, 1 (so mettāsahagatena cetasā ekaṃ disaṃ pharitvā viharati tathā dutiyaṃ tathā tatiyaṃ tathā catutthaṃ); II 168, 1* (manussaseṭṭhehi tath’ eva pūjito); Dhp 220 (tath’ eva katapuññaṃ pi asmā lokā paraṃ gataṃ puññāni paṭigaṇhanti); It 23, 10* (jivhā kāyo tathā mano); Sn 33 (nandati puttehi puttimā … gomiko gohi tath’ eva nandati); 297 (annadā baladā c’ etā vaṇṇadā sukhadā tathā); Vv 64:17 (hatthesu pādesu tath’ eva sīse); Ja I 137, 27 (so caturāsītivassasahassāni kumāra-kīḷaṃ tathā oparajjaṃ tathā mahārajjaṃ katvā); IV 373, 29 (paccekabuddho tassa dhammaṃ desetvā sakaṭṭhānam eva gato tathā tāpaso); Ap 2, 8 (maṇimayā lohitaṅkā masāragallamayā tathā); Vism 571, 11 (kammam eva bhavo kammabhavo tathā uppatti yeva bhavo uppattibhavo); Sp 994, 21 (tassa cīvaraṃ pariyesitabbaṃ pattaṃ pi tath’ eva); Mp IV 67, 21 (api ca dīghanikāye saṅgītisuttavaṇṇanāyaṃ pi vitthārito yeva tathā majjhimanikāye sāmagāmasuttavaṇṇanāyaṃ pī ti); Mhv 23:98 (tassa yodhasatassāpi tath’ eva pariyesituṃ); — 3. yes, so be it ; Pv 20:6 (tathā ti vatvā agamāsi tattha Pv-a 109, 13 : tathā ti vatvā ti sādhū ti vatvā) ≠ 36:41 ( Be, Ce, Ee so; Se tathā hi); — 4. ( as correlative to yathā): Sadd 896, 30 (yathā tathā yath’ eva tath’ eva … paṭibhāgatthe); ( i ) in that way; in such a manner … that ; Vin III 12, 30 (so ’haṃ bhante tathā karissāmi yathā maṃ mātāpitaro anujānissanti agārasmā anagāriyaṃ pabbajjāyā ti); S I 11, 29 (sādhu me bhante bhagavā tathā bhāsatu yathāhaṃ … atthaṃ jāneyyan ti); 114, 15 (tathā nu tvaṃ pāpima akāsi yathāhaṃ piṇḍaṃ na labheyyan ti); 186, 4* (tathā maccu karissāmi na me maggaṃ pi dakkhasi); Dhp 282 (tath’ attānaṃ niveseyya yathā bhūrī pavaḍḍhati); Ud 25, 22 (handa mayaṃ āvuso tathā vihāraṃ kappema yathā no viharataṃ bhagavā attamano assā ti, Be, Ce, Ee so; Se atthakāmo assā ti); Pv 27:13 (tathā bhante parakkama yathā vatthaṃ labhāmase); Ja I 227, 21 (yathā ime etaṃ gharaṃ na pavisanti tathā mayā kātuṃ vaṭṭatī ti); Vism 208, 9 (bhagavā hi tathā purisadamme sāreti yathā ekapallaṅken’ eva nisinnā aṭṭha disā asajjamānā dhāvanti); — repeated : It 93, 19 (tathā tathā bhikkhave bhikkhu upaparikkheyya yathā yathā upaparikkhato bahiddhā c’ assa viññāṇaṃ avikkhittaṃ hoti; It-a II 119, 29 : tathā tathā ti tena tena pakārena); — (ii ) as … so … ; Vin II 290, 8 (yath’ eva mayā bhagavato sammukhā sutaṃ sammukhā paṭiggahitaṃ tath’ evāhaṃ dhāressāmī ti); III 109, 23 (yathā pure tathā pacchā pārājiko hoti asaṃvāso); D I 60, 4 (tena hi mahārāja taṃ yev’ ettha paṭipucchissāmi, yathā te khameyya tathā naṃ vyākareyyāsi); S I 114, 10 (yathā dhotena pattena … brāhmaṇagāmaṃ piṇḍāya pāvisi tathā dhotena pattena paṭikkami); Dhp 159 (attānaṃ ce tathā kayirā yathaññam anusāsati); Sn 705 (yathā ahaṃ tathā ete yathā ete tathā ahaṃ attānaṃ upamaṃ katvā na haneyya na ghātaye); Vv p. 43, 12 (anantaraṃ caturavimānaṃ yathā vatthadāyikāvimānaṃ tathā vitthāretabbaṃ); Pv 12:3 (yathā gato tathā gato tattha kā paridevanā); Th 497 (attā ca naṃ yathā vedi devā pi naṃ tathā vidū); Ja III 105, 22* (yathā dhammo tathā kare); Ap 92, 14 (yathodayanto ādicco vinodeti tamaṃ sadā tath’ eva tvaṃ buddhaseṭṭha viddhaṃsesi tamaṃ sadā); Vibh 393, 34 (yathā so khattiyo nāhaṃ tathā khattiyo ’smī ti); Vism 243, 6 (yathā pana vacasā tath’ eva manasā pi sajjhāyo kātabbo); Mp III 225, 20 (tathāgatabalānī ti yathā tehi gantabbaṃ tath’ eva gatāni pavattāni ñāṇabalāni); — repeated : D I 185, 17 foll. (yathā yathā kho Poṭṭhapāda nirodhaṃ phusati tathā tathā ’haṃ saññaggaṃ paññāpemi); M I 32, 2 (yathā yathā … ājīvikassa … cetaso parivitakkitaṃ hoti tathā tathā … yānakāraputto tassā nemiyā … taṃ ca dosaṃ tacchati; Ps I 151, 31 : tathā tathā ti ayaṃ pi kālatthe yeva, tasmiṃ tasmiṃ kāle ti vuttaṃ hoti); 171, 27 (yathā yathā kho ahaṃ bhikkhave upasaṅkamiṃ tathā tathā pañcavaggiyā bhikkhū nāsakkhiṃsu sakāya katikāya saṇṭhātuṃ); S I 237, 24 (yathā yathā kho bhikkhave devā Tāvatiṃsā ujjhāyanti … tathā tathā so yakkho abhirūpataro c ’eva hoti …); A I 249, 9 (yathā yathāyaṃ puriso kammaṃ karoti tathā tathā taṃ paṭisaṃvediyatī ti); Ja III 205, 8* (yathā yathā yattha labhetha atthaṃ tathā tathā tattha parakkameyya); — yathā vā tathā vā, however, in whatever way ; Ja V 130, 1 (yathā vā tathā vā pātesi); — tatha-r-iva , [tathā + eva; BHS id. ], just so, in the same way ; Abh 1143; Dhātuk 65, 3* (tayo paṭicca tatha-r-iva phassapañcamā, Be, Ce, Se so; Ee wr ttariva); Sadd 618, 12 (saramhā parassa evasaddassa ekārassa rikāro hoti pubbo ca saro rasso hoti na vā: yatha-r-iva vasudhātalaṃ ca sabbaṃ tatha-r-iva guṇavā supūjanīyo); 897, 11 (tatha-r-iva bhagavā ti); — tathā pi , and so; even so; nevertheless ; Ja II 442, 19´ (assa mahāsamuddassa sace pi naṃ sakalo loko piveyya tathāpi ito ettakaṃ nāma udakaṃ pītan ti pariyanto na paññāyati); VI 499, 20´ (sace pi me pāṇā piyataro so tathā pi naṃ pabbājemī ti, Be, Se so; Ce, Ee pāṇehi piyataro); Vism 135, 34* (sace sā nappavattati tathā pi na jahe yogaṃ); Cp-a 85, 18 (imaṃ Vessantaramahārājaṃ dānena hetunā Sivayo raṭṭhato nīharanti pabbājenti, tathā pi puna evarūpaṃ dānaṃ deti ayan ti); — tathā hi , for so; for thus (it has been said); for instance; because ; Vin III 69, 26 (kiṃ nu kho Ānanda tanubhūto viya bhikkhusaṅgho ti, tathā hi … te sakena kāyena aṭṭiyanti …); 162, 12 (kissa maṃ ayyā nālapantī ti, tathā hi pana tvaṃ bhagini amhe Dabbena Mallaputtena viheṭhiyamāne ajjhupekkhasī ti); D II 348, 1 (tumhe khv ettha bhaṇe ummattā tumhe vicetā tathā hi pana me sūkarabhattan ti); M I 225, 12 (taṃ kissa hetu, tathā hi so … gopālako duppaññajātiko …); A V 41, 9 (na ayaṃ āyasmā tathā pajānāti yathā pajānato lobho na hoti tathā h ’imaṃ āyasmantaṃ lobho abhibhuyya iriyati); 166, 21 (naṃ sabrahmacārī … na pūjenti, taṃ kissa hetu, tathā hi ’ssa bhikkhave viññū sabrahmacārī …); Sn 504 (tvaṃ h’ ettha jānāsi yathātathā idaṃ tathā hi te vidito esa dhammo); Pv 50:2 (na anto paṭidissati tathā hi pakataṃ pāpaṃ mama tuyhaṃ ca); Ja III 199, 4* (n’ eva taṃ yācito dajjaṃ tathā hi bhayatajjito; 199, 14´ : ahaṃ tayā yācito na dadeyyaṃ kiṃkāraṇā, tathā hi bhayatajjito ti); V 214, 20* (nāmaṃ idaṃ imissā … kataṃ susādhu tathā hi mayhaṃ avalokayantī ummattakaṃ Ummadantī akāsi); 437, 25 (tathā hi: atīte pana Bārāṇasiyaṃ …); Ap 28, 16 (sabbe migā uttasanti migarājassa gajjato tathā hi jātimā eso pasū tāseti sabbadā); Vism 143, 22 (ubbegā pīti balavatī hoti … tathā hi Puṇṇavallikavāsī Mahātissatthero …); Sp 228, 29 (sāsane kira yo yo upaddavo … uppajji sabbaṃ taṃ Vajjiputtake nissāya tathā hi Devadatto pi Vajjiputtake pakkhe labhitvā saṅghaṃ bhindi); Th-a I 26, 23 (kuṭikā ti pana mātukucchi pi karajakāyo pi … vuccati, tathā hi mātaraṃ kuṭikaṃ brūsi …); Cp-a 247, 18 (tathā hi vuttaṃ …); Sadd 370, 8 ; 902, 20 (hi tathā hi icc ete daḷhīkaraṇatthe vuttaṃ hi tathā hi vuttaṃ); — °’- atta , mfn. [tathā + atta 3 ?], being of such a character ;? D III 176, 11* (~o yadi bhavati tathāvidho idha disā ca paṭidisā ca vidisā ca; Sv 940, 4 : ~o ti tathā-sabhāvo); S I 187, 32* (dhammadaso ti tam āhu ~aṃ, Ce, Se so; Be pahitattaṃ; Ee dhammarato ti) = Th 1221 ( eds so ; Th-a III 191, 34 foll. : taṃ tathābhāvaṃ sammā-paṭipannaṃ yāthāvato dhammadassī ti paṇḍitā āhu); — °’- ûpama , mfn. [ from tathā + upamā], similar to that, like that ; M I 156, 7 (seyyathā pi te bhikkhave paṭhamā migajātā ~e ahaṃ ime paṭhame samaṇabrāhmaṇe vadāmi); Sn 229 (yath’ indakhīlo paṭhaviṃ sito siyā … ~aṃ sappurisaṃ vadāmi); Ja V 4, 3* (yathā mahā vāridharo … ~aṃ ambapakkaṃ); VI 526, 21* (assatthaṃ va pathe jātaṃ … ~aṃ mahārājaṃ ko me Vessantaraṃ vidū); Pp 33, 14 (seyyathā pi so potthako dubbaṇṇo ~o ayaṃ puggalo); Vism 401, 30 (~aṃ etaṃ pāṭihāriyaṃ); — ~aṃ, adv. , like that; in a similar way ; Vin I 5, 35* (sele yathā pabbamuddhani ṭṭhito yathā pi passe janataṃ samantato ~aṃ dhammamayaṃ sumedha pāsādam āruyha samantacakkhu … avekkhassu) = D II 39, 12* ( cf Sv 470, 12 : ~an ti tappaṭibhāgaṃ selapabbatūpamaṃ); Vv 65:1 (yathā vanaṃ Cittalataṃ pabhāsati … ~aṃ tuyham idaṃ vimānaṃ obhāsayaṃ tiṭṭhati); Th 1121 (~aṃ citta idaṃ karosi); — °- gata , see sv ; — °- gataka , m ( fn )., (one) who goes in that way, goes accordingly ; D I 222, 30 (sace so samantā tīraṃ passati ~o va hoti, Be, Ce, Ee so; Se tathāpakkanto) = A III 368, 29 ; — °(tatha)- tā , f. [ or tatha + tā; S. tathātā ( and tathatā? see L. Renou, 1975, p. 189 ); BHS also tathatā], the state of being so; the true state of things ; S II 26, 5 (yā tatra ~ā avitathatā anaññathatā idappaccayatā idaṃ vuccati bhikkhave paṭiccasamuppādo); Kv 583, 26 (sabbadhammānaṃ ~ā asaṅkhatā ti); — °(tatha)- tta , n. [ and/or tatha + tta; S. tathātva; BHS also tathatva], the being like that; such a state; the state of being so; the true state of things ; D II 57, 12 (tesaṃ tesaṃ va hi Ānanda sattānaṃ ~āya jāti nābhavissa; Sv 498, 8 : ~āyā ti devagandhabbādibhāvāya); III 120, 31 (yo ca samādapeti yaṃ ca samādapeti yo ca samādapito ~āya paṭipajjati sabbe te bahuṃ puññaṃ pasavanti); M I 87, 35 (paraṃ vā ~āya samādapessanti yathāpaṭipanno kāme parijānissatī ti); 301, 36 (atha khv assa pubbe va tathā cittaṃ bhāvitaṃ hoti yaṃ taṃ ~āya upanetī ti); S V 90, 6 (maggo ca paṭiladdho yo me bhāvito bahulīkato tathā tathā viharantaṃ ~āya upanessati yathāhaṃ khīṇā jāti vusitaṃ brahmacariyaṃ nāparaṃ itthattāyā ti pajānissāmi); Sn 520 (samaṇo tādi pavuccate ~ā); Mil 255, 5 (so ca ~āya paṭipajjeyya); Vism 149, 1 (purimacittaṃ eka-santatipariṇāmanayena ~aṃ upagacchamānaṃ); 512, 26 (itaraṃ pana ariyasaccadvayaṃ siyā dukkhaṃ aniccato na pana yassa pariññāya bhagavati brahmacariyaṃ vussati ~ena, Be, Se so; Ce, Ee tathatthena); Pj II 483, 8 (sāvakaṃ moneyyapaṭipadaṃ paṭipannaṃ disvā ~aṃ abhikaṅkhamāno); Sadd 805, 19 foll. (tathābhāvo ~aṃ … ~āya paṭipajjatī ti ca ādīni nidassanāni bhavanti tattha ~āyā ti tathābhāvāyā ti attho); — °- dassi(n) , mfn. , see sv tatha ; — °- pavattika , mfn. , proceeding so ; It-a I 121, 15 (~o ti tathāgato; = Ud-a 133, 8 : tathā pavattito); 136, 15 foll. (kathaṃ ~o ti tathāgato … yathā ruci tathā gataṃ gati gamanaṃ kāyavacīcittappavatti etassā ti tathāgato; = Ud-a 152, 19 foll. : tathā pavattito); — °- bhāva , m. , the state of being so; such a condition ; Ja I 279, 27 (bodhisatto tathābhāvaṃ ñatvā); Sadd 805, 19 foll. ; — °- rūpa , mf (~ā, ~ī) n. , such a …; like this or that; of such a kind; ( i ) following a defining phrase : Vin II 249, 10 (ye te dhammā ādikalyāṇā … ~ā me dhammā bahussutā …); III 1, 21 (sādhu kho pana ~ānaṃ arahataṃ dassanaṃ hotī ti); 191, 29 (yo pana bhikkhu ~e āsane mātugāmena saddhiṃ … nisajjaṃ kappeyya); IV 166, 12 (yo pana bhikkhu … vikāle gāmaṃ paviseyya aññatra ~ā accāyikā karaṇīyā pācittiyan ti); D I 4, 27 (yā sā vācā nelā … ~iṃ vācaṃ bhāsitā ti); II 80, 31 (yāvakīvaṃ ca bhikkhave bhikkhū yā ’yaṃ diṭṭhi ariyā niyyānikā niyyāti takkarassa sammādukkhakkhayāya ~āya diṭṭhiyā diṭṭhisāmaññagatā viharissanti …); M III 132, 30 (yā sā vācā nelā … ~āhi vācāhi samudācarati); 169, 29 (yāni tāni nīcakulāni … ~e kule paccājāyati daḷidde …); A III 289, 32 (ye te lābhā dhammikā … ~ehi lābhehi appaṭivibhattabhogī hoti …); 351, 21 (yathārūpena Ānanda sīlena Purāṇo samannāgato ahosi ~ena sīlena Isidatto sammannāgato abhavissa); 391, 11 (ye te bhikkhū āraññakā … ~esu bhante bhikkhūsu dānaṃ dīyatī ti); Dhp 105 (jitaṃ apajitaṃ kayirā ~assa jantuno); Ja IV 105, 8 (te taṃ suvaṇṇarūpakaṃ sakalaJambudīpaṃ pariharāpetvā ~aṃ itthiṃ alabhantā); Mil 353, 9 (~ena ācariyena kalyāṇamittena); Vism 136, 23 (~esu ṭhānesu kammaṃ katva); 707, 13 (satthā otiṇṇe vatthusmiṃ sikkhāpadaṃ vā paññāpeti ~āya vā aṭṭhuppattiyā dhammaṃ deseti); Sv 546, 3 (atha nesaṃ rajja-sirisampattiṃ disvā ṭhitabhikkhu ~āya pi nāma sirisampattiyā vināso paññāyissatī ti); — ( ii ) followed by yathārūpa, yathā or another relative pronoun : Vin I 16, 17 (yannūnāhaṃ ~aṃ iddhābhisaṅkhāraṃ abhi-saṅkhareyyaṃ yathā seṭṭhī gahapati idha nisinno idha nisinnaṃ Yasaṃ kulaputtaṃ na passeyyā ti); D I 13, 13 (~aṃ cetosamādhiṃ phusati yathā samāhite citte anekavihitaṃ pubbenivāsaṃ anussarati); M I 324, 9 (kiñcāpi ~iṃ āpattiṃ āpajjati yathārūpāya āpattiyā vuṭṭhānaṃ paññāyati); III 80, 8 foll.
